ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: dense white mottling concentrated in the distal half and along the upper margin. Right lobe: distinct vertical high-intensity streaks (at least 4-5) originating near the trailing edge and distal mottling at the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad U-shaped depression; visible divergence angle approximately 85 degrees; lower apex obscured by white-water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the medial trailing edge; transitioning to irregular, high-amplitude jagged protrusions at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the central 60% of both trailing edges, tapering to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, irregular pixel aggregates (roughly circular/oval) concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical high-contrast linear disruptions on the right lobe; sparse, non-aligned diagonal streaks visible on the left lobe's upper quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified/irregular growth masses at both distal tips; significant white-water occlusion at the proximal-medial junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized area of high-intensity 'white-water' noise (spray) obscuring the lower boundary of the left lobe and the central fluke junction.
